placements.title: Standardizing team operating cadences and retrospective practices
placements.frame: How are team operating cadences, review rituals, and continuous improvement processes structured?

placements.title: Standardizing sprint retrospectives on the three-part Velociraptor format
placements.frame: What structure and format govern team retrospective rituals to surface sprint progress, delays, and critical failures?
placements.why: The segments collectively define an active shift in team retrospective methodology, replacing the start-stop-continue model with the structured Velociraptor framework (Sailed, Stalled, Capsized).
